_what: Otočac, Rođeni 1846-1858 + Umrli 1834-1858 — the book, its waypoint, and an ARK map.
_the_trap: The film-number URL /search/film/005482657 reports **483 images**. The Otočac book is **218**. From about image 219 the traversal crosses into a different parish entirely — **Pakrac** — and every sample taken there was a baptism, which is why a first attempt concluded the deaths were not on the film at all. A film number is not a book.

_how_to_browse: Use /search/image/index?owc=9RK1-Y4C%3A391644801%2C391674001%3Fcc%3D2040054&cc=2040054 to land in the book. To step, the film-number URL /en/search/film/005482657?i=<N-1> works and stays inside Otočac for N <= 218 — but NOT beyond. Adding &i= to an ARK URL does not move the viewer.
